title: Bootstrap staging stack by stack in its dedicated account
description:
## Plan step 8 (human-run, never cdk deploy --all; extends chatticus-7ebd57)
With the staging account SSO session, per stack: sh infra/deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh staging STACK. Confirm budgets, snapshots, computers, thin-turn exist; zones; delegate from the management zone and verify with dig (needs legacy to release staging.chattic.us first, D7); certificates; seed Google OAuth secret and OpenAI parameter by hand; control-plane; auth; web. Repoint the staging environment's AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN to the dedicated account only now (verify with verify-account-deploy-role.yml). Account facts come from AGENTS.local.md, never the board.
## Acceptance
- conversation/bin/acceptance.ts --environment staging passes; a signed-in smoke turn succeeds.
- Blocked on hostname release, Google secrets, OpenAI key, per-environment ECR image tag.
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed.
